text:
Ryan: Heads-up — saw a small but sharp billing spike in EU this morning. Looks like duplicated token events tied to websocket reconnects.
Maya: Any example traces?
Ryan: Pasted a tiny snip from the raw trace:```json
{
  "resume_id": "res_abc123",
  "route": "eu-west-1-a",
  "event": "reconnect",
  "billed_tokens": 246
}```We have two reconnect entries for the same resume_id within 3s.
Akash: Hmm — could be partial PONG handling at the edge. Proxy thinks socket is alive, client reconnects, resume succeeds on a different shard -> meter double-counts.
Laura: Console shows route-level billing up 2x for that customer. Metering backend shows duplicate events, but the trace id is identical. Telemetry joins might be dropping resume_id so UI aggregates separately.
Taylor: Is resume_id in the auth header or in the query param? If it's in URL we might be normalizing differently at the proxy.
Ryan: Clients send `Resume-Id` as header, but our LB rewrites/upstreams sometimes move it into `X-Resume` for legacy proxies. Could cause two distinct canonical keys.
Maya: Quick check: show me the nginx proxy logs for one of the affected traces?
Akash: grabbing logs...```text
Mar 21 05:12:03 edge eu-west-1-a proxy[pid]: conn=789 client=1.2.3.4 resume=res_abc123 upstream=10.0.2.5
Mar 21 05:12:05 edge eu-west-1-a proxy[pid]: conn=790 client=1.2.3.4 resume= res_abc123 upstream=10.0.3.7
```Note the extra space in second line — some ingress normalization added it.
Laura: That would make the meter treat `res_abc123` and ` res_abc123` as different keys. Console join query escapes whitespace differently, hence mismatch.
Taylor: Blegh. Two issues: ingress normalization bug and metering not de-duplicating resume ids. Which do we fix first?
Akash: Fast mitigation: add a meter-layer idempotency filter that canonicalizes resume id (trim, lower) and dedup events within 10s window. Low-risk and rollbackable via feature flag.
Ryan: Agreed. Longer-term: tighten ingress header handling so we never introduce whitespace and add a resume_id normalizer in the router.
Maya: For rollout UX: can we expose an annotation in Console per-route that flags routes with >1% resume_id-dup rate? That would help customers see affected shards.
Laura: We should also add a Telemetry dashboard tile: `rate(duplicate_resume_count[5m]) by (route)` and wire an alert when it crosses threshold.
observability-bot: Query suggestion: `sum by (route)(rate(meter_duplicate_resume{job="meter"}[5m]))` — can create a panel.
infra-bot: Canary deploy started: `canary-meter-normalizer v2026.03.21-rc1` -> 10% traffic eu-west. Watch `meter_duplicate_resume` and `billed_tokens` closely.
Taylor: Edge case: some clients legitimately reconnect and resume twice quickly (e.g., flaky mobile). Dedup window needs tuning. Start with 10s, we'll tune with canary.
Akash: Also debating internal API change: enforce resume_id in `Resume-Id` header on public API and reject if found in query param. Pro: simpler normalization. Con: breaks some older SDKs. Might require a soft-deprecation period.
Maya: Can we instead do translation at the edge (if query param present -> inject header and log deprecation metric) to avoid client break?
Taylor: That seems safer. Add metric `resume_id_loc` with labels header|query so we can measure adoption.
Laura: Action items: 1) Akash -> implement meter-layer canonicalizer & dedupe (feature flag). 2) Akash -> add `resume_id_loc` metric. 3) Maya -> add console panel + alert. 4) Ryan -> file ingress normalization bug and schedule fix. 5) Taylor -> rollout plan for canary and thresholds.
Ryan: Pushed a short PR to docs/ingress with the whitespace-sanity check. @Akash will you paste the canary dashboards once live? :thumbsup:
Akash: Yep. I'll post the Grafana links and a follow-up once 10% looks good.
Maya: I'll draft an ops note for customers that saw spikes, include suggested mitigation (restart clients if possible) and that we're patching infra.
Taylor: Thanks everyone. Keep alerts in #oncall. If `billed_tokens` delta > 5000 in 5m in eu-west, page me.
observability-bot: Alert rule created: `eu-west-large-billing-delta` (sensitivity=high).
